title: Retrieve hydrological data from the Oregon Water Resources Department — get_owrd_hydro
text: station_nbr Character. OWRD station number. Defaults "14076100". start_date Character Date. Start date data request. coerced Date — format accepted .Date() works. end_date Character Date. End date data request. coerced Date — format accepted .Date() works. data_source Character. type hydrological data retrieve. One : "MDF" Mean daily flow "Instantaneous_Flow" Instantaneous flow "WTEMP15" Instantaneous water temperature (15-min) "WTEMP_MEAN" Mean daily water temperature "WTEMP_MAX" Maximum daily water temperature "WTEMP_MIN" Minimum daily water temperature Defaults "MDF". Partial matching supported via match.arg(). max_retries Integer. Number times retry GET/POST sequence failure giving . Defaults 3. timeout_sec Numeric. Per-request timeout seconds. Defaults 30.

title: Retrieve hydrological data from the Oregon Water Resources Department — get_owrd_hydro
text: tibble cleaned column names (via janitor::clean_names()) containing requested hydrological data specified station date range. Column names units vary data_source.

title: Retrieve hydrological data from the Oregon Water Resources Department — get_owrd_hydro
text: function scrapes OWRD Near Real-Time Hydrograph web application (https://apps.wrd.state..us/apps/sw/hydro_near_real_time/). performs initial GET request retrieve ASP.NET form state (__VIEWSTATE etc.) submitting POST request download data TSV format. persistent session handle used preserve cookies across requests. form containing __VIEWSTATE located explicitly (ID first, field content) rather assumed first form page, since OWRD may add unrelated forms (banners, widgets) ahead real one. browser-like User-Agent sent requests, GET/POST sequence retried backoff transient failures.
